Merlín the Duck Barred from Mexico Match Due to FIFA Rules

Merlín the duck, a two-year-old animal, was prevented from attending Mexico's match against Czechia on Wednesday. FIFA regulations prohibit animals from entering stadiums, leading to Merlín's exclusion. The duck has gained popularity in Mexico, becoming a "folk hero" and a symbol for some.
